question: What is the total sales revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales;

question: Show top 5 best selling products by revenue
sql: SELECT product, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the total sales by payment method?
sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

question: Which city has the highest sales revenue?
sql: SELECT city, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show sales breakdown by shop name
sql: SELECT shop_name, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales GROUP BY shop_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

question: What is the total quantity of units sold across all shops?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM shop_sales;

question: List all transactions paid via Credit Card
sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales WHERE payment_method = 'Credit Card' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

question: Show sales in Mumbai
sql: SELECT city, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales GROUP BY city HAVING city = 'Mumbai';

question: What is the average transaction sales amount?
sql: SELECT AVG(sales) FROM shop_sales;

question: Show top selling products by quantity sold
sql: SELECT product, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM shop_sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_qty DESC;

question: Which product generated the highest total profit?
sql: SELECT product, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show total profit by city
sql: SELECT city, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

question: What is the overall profit across all sales?
sql: SELECT SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales;

question: Show profit by shop name sorted from highest to lowest
sql: SELECT shop_name, city, COUNT(transaction_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold, ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales GROUP BY shop_name, city ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

question: Which category has the highest profit margin?
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(ss.profit) AS total_profit FROM products p JOIN shop_sales ss ON p.sku = ss.product GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

question: Which products are currently out of stock?
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.category, p.size, p.color FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point;

question: Show products where stock count is less than or equal to reorder point
sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.style_name, i.sku) AS product, i.sku, i.stock_count AS current_stock, i.reorder_point, CASE WHEN i.stock_count <= 0 THEN MAX(i.reorder_point * 2, 20) WHEN i.stock_count < i.reorder_point THEN (i.reorder_point - i.stock_count) + i.reorder_point ELSE i.reorder_point END AS recommended_reorder_qty, ROUND(COALESCE(p.unit_cost, 25.0), 2) AS estimated_unit_cost FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point ORDER BY (i.reorder_point - i.stock_count) DESC LIMIT 15;

question: What is the total stock count across all products in inventory?
sql: SELECT SUM(stock_count) FROM inventory;

question: Show inventory levels for all products sorted by stock count ascending
sql: SELECT i.stock_count FROM inventory AS i INNER JOIN products AS p ON i.sku = p.sku ORDER BY i.stock_count ASC;

question: Which product has the highest stock count?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.style_name, i.sku) AS product, i.sku, i.stock_count AS current_stock, i.reorder_point, i.location, CASE WHEN i.stock_count <= 0 THEN 'Out of Stock' WHEN i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point THEN 'Low Stock' ELSE 'Healthy Stock' END AS stock_status FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.sku = p.sku ORDER BY i.stock_count ASC LIMIT 20;

question: Show all inventory items located in Warehouse A
sql: SELECT i.sku, p.style_name, i.stock_count, i.reorder_point FROM inventory AS i JOIN products AS p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE i.location = 'Warehouse A';

question: List products that have stock count greater than 50
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count > 50;

question: Show high risk products with stockout risk
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.category, p.size, p.color, i.stock_count, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point;

question: Show dead stock products that have had no recent sales
sql: SELECT p.sku, p.style_name, p.category, p.size, p.color, i.stock_count FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point AND p.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM sales_events);

question: Which products have critical stock below 5 units?
sql: SELECT p.sku, p.style_name, p.category, p.size, p.color, i.stock_count, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point AND i.stock_count < 5;

question: Which suppliers have an on time delivery rate below 85%?
sql: SELECT supplier_name FROM suppliers WHERE on_time_rate < 0.85;

question: List all suppliers and their lead times sorted by lead time days
sql: SELECT supplier_name, lead_time_days FROM suppliers ORDER BY lead_time_days;

question: What is the average supplier lead time in days?
sql: SELECT shop_name, city, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS unique_products_sold, COUNT(transaction_id) AS total_transactions, SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold, ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_revenue FROM shop_sales GROUP BY shop_name, city ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Which supplier has the highest on time rate?
sql: SELECT supplier_name FROM suppliers ORDER BY on_time_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many total suppliers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(supplier_id) FROM suppliers;

question: List suppliers from India
sql: SELECT supplier_name FROM suppliers WHERE supplier_name LIKE '%India%';

question: Show all purchase orders with status PENDING
sql: SELECT po_id, sku, qty, status, total_cost FROM purchase_orders WHERE status = 'PENDING';

question: What is the total quantity ordered in purchase orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(qty) FROM purchase_orders;

question: List all purchase orders for SKU-1001
sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.style_name, i.sku) AS product, i.sku, i.stock_count AS current_stock, i.reorder_point, CASE WHEN i.stock_count <= 0 THEN MAX(i.reorder_point * 2, 20) WHEN i.stock_count < i.reorder_point THEN (i.reorder_point - i.stock_count) + i.reorder_point ELSE i.reorder_point END AS recommended_reorder_qty, ROUND(COALESCE(p.unit_cost, 25.0), 2) AS estimated_unit_cost FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE p.sku = 'SKU-1001' AND i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point ORDER BY (i.reorder_point - i.stock_count) DESC LIMIT 15;

question: Show recent purchase orders sorted by id descending
sql: SELECT po_id FROM purchase_orders ORDER BY po_id DESC;

question: Show purchase orders grouped by status with count
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(po_id) AS count FROM purchase_orders GROUP BY status;

question: How many total products exist in the catalog?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;

question: What is the average retail price of products?
sql: SELECT AVG(retail_price) FROM products;

question: Show the 5 most expensive products by retail price
sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.style_name, i.sku) AS product, i.sku, i.stock_count AS current_stock, i.reorder_point, i.location, CASE WHEN i.stock_count <= 0 THEN 'Out of Stock' WHEN i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point THEN 'Low Stock' ELSE 'Healthy Stock' END AS stock_status FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.sku = p.sku ORDER BY i.stock_count ASC LIMIT 20;

question: List all products in the Footwear category
sql: SELECT style_name FROM products WHERE category = 'Footwear';

question: Show all products with retail price greater than 50
sql: SELECT style_name, retail_price FROM products WHERE retail_price > 50;

question: List distinct product categories
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS num_products, SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold, COUNT(transaction_id) AS num_transactions, ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Show all products available in size M
sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.style_name, i.sku) AS product, i.sku, i.stock_count AS current_stock, i.reorder_point, i.location, CASE WHEN i.stock_count <= 0 THEN 'Out of Stock' WHEN i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point THEN 'Low Stock' ELSE 'Healthy Stock' END AS stock_status FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.sku = p.sku ORDER BY i.stock_count ASC LIMIT 20;

question: Which products have unit cost less than 20?
sql: SELECT product, category, SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold, ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit, ROUND((SUM(profit) / MAX(SUM(sales), 1.0)) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct FROM shop_sales GROUP BY product, category ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 15;

question: Show products and their profit margin (retail price minus unit cost)
sql: SELECT product, category, SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold, ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM(profit), 2) AS total_profit, ROUND((SUM(profit) / MAX(SUM(sales), 1.0)) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct FROM shop_sales GROUP BY product, category ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 15;

question: Show product style name, stock count, and supplier name
sql: SELECT p.style_name, i.stock_count, s.supplier_name FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku JOIN suppliers s ON p.sku = s.supplier_id;

question: Which supplier provides the products with the lowest stock?
sql: SELECT s.supplier_name FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON 1=1 JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point ORDER BY i.stock_count LIMIT 1;

question: Show style name and reorder point for all products
sql: SELECT p.style_name, i.reorder_point FROM products p INNER JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point;

question: List products with their current stock and retail price
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.retail_price, i.stock_count FROM products p INNER JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku;

question: Show supplier name for Oxford Shirt
sql: SELECT s.supplier_name FROM suppliers s JOIN purchase_orders po ON s.supplier_id = po.sku JOIN products p ON po.sku = p.sku WHERE p.style_name = 'Oxford Shirt';

question: List all warehouses and their cities
sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.location, s.city FROM inventory AS i INNER JOIN shop_sales AS s ON i.location = s.shop_name;

question: What is the total capacity across all warehouses?
sql: SELECT SUM(stock_count) FROM inventory;

question: Which warehouse has the highest capacity?
sql: SELECT location FROM inventory ORDER BY stock_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show sales in Delhi paid with Cash
sql: SELECT SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales WHERE city = 'Delhi' AND payment_method = 'Cash';

question: What is the total profit for Electronics category?
sql: SELECT SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales WHERE category = 'Electronics';

question: Count how many transactions were made in each city
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM shop_sales GROUP BY city;

question: Show average units sold per sales event
sql: SELECT AVG(units_sold) FROM sales_events;

question: Find products that have zero stock but reorder point greater than 10
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.category, p.size, p.color FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count = 0 AND i.reorder_point > 10;

question: Show total sales and total profit by shop name in Mumbai
sql: SELECT shop_name, SUM(sales) AS total_sales, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales WHERE city = 'Mumbai' GROUP BY shop_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

question: List top 3 cities with the lowest total sales
sql: SELECT city, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_sales ASC LIMIT 3;
